KM70-10 Product Overview

Description

The KM70-10 is a compact joint module for robot arms and exoskeletons. A 10:1 planetary stage gives it a rated torque of 8.3 N·m in a 521 g housing.

The hollow shaft has an 11 mm bore, so cables can run through the joint instead of around it.

Features

  • Dual absolute encoders
  • Integrated FOC driver
  • CAN 2.0B and UART
  • Hollow shaft, 11 mm bore

Ratings

Parameter Value
Rated torque 8.3 N·m
Peak torque 24.8 N·m
Rated speed 145 rpm
Weight 521 g

Mounting

Six M3 threads on a 60 mm circle hold the output flange. The housing mounts with four M4 screws.
